title: Woodland Animals Coloring Book for Adults, Bold and Easy
subtitle: 50 Cute Cozy Forest Creatures with Cottagecore Autumn Scenes, Simple Big Designs for Relaxation
description:
Escape into the enchanting forest and color your way through cozy woodland moments!


This delightful coloring book features 50 adorable woodland animal illustrations drawn in a cute kawaii cottagecore style with bold, easy-to-color outlines. Meet charming foxes curled up on mossy logs, owls reading by lantern light, deer wandering through golden meadows, hedgehogs carrying apples through autumn leaves, and raccoons baking pies in cozy tree-trunk kitchens.

What's Inside:
• 50 unique woodland animal illustrations
• Foxes, deer, owls, hedgehogs, raccoons, bunnies, squirrels, bears, and more
• Cozy autumn forest scenes with cottages, streams, meadows, and campfires
• Single-sided pages to prevent bleed-through
• Large 8.5 x 8.5 inch square pages for comfortable coloring
• Bold, easy-to-color outlines perfect for colored pencils, markers, and gel pens

Perfect For:
• Relaxation and stress relief after a long day
• Nature lovers and autumn enthusiasts
• A thoughtful gift for animal lovers and cottagecore fans
• Beginners and experienced colorists alike

Grab your favorite warm-toned pencils and lose yourself in the magic of the woodland!
